claims.statement: Persistent self-models and uncertainty-awareness mechanisms enable multi-model architectures to maintain operational history and regulate action authority independently of task execution.

support.explanation: Demonstrates that persistent self-models and decoupled meta-cognitive monitoring provide the structural components needed to track operational state across turns.
support.passage: a persistent self-model (Σ) representing system identity, boundaries, and operational history; (2) uncertainty-awareness mechanisms (U) generating reliability signals contextualized by declared authority; (3) a meta-cognitive evaluation layer (E) monitoring system state independently of task execution
